meta.name: generate
meta.description: Generate Playwright tests. Use when user says "write tests", "generate tests", "add tests for", "test this component", "e2e test", "create test for", "test this page", or "test this feature".

copy.tagline: 自动为网页和组件生成端到端测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为前端功能编写自动化测试
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate end-to-end tests for web pages and components
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to write automated tests for frontend features

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据用户描述、组件名或功能需求，自动生成 Playwright 端到端测试代码，包括测试文件、页面对象和测试数据。
howto.when: 当用户说出“写测试”、“生成测试”、“为…添加测试”、“测试这个组件”、“e2e 测试”、“创建测试”、“测试这个页面”或“测试这个功能”时触发。

say.text: 为登录功能生成 Playwright 测试。
say.note: Claude 会分析登录流程并生成测试文件。
Claude 会读取组件源码并生成对应测试。

say.text: 为搜索页面添加 e2e 测试。
say.note: Claude 会识别搜索页面并生成测试。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate Playwright end-to-end test code based on user descriptions, component names, or feature requirements, including test files, page objects, and test data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "write tests", "generate tests", "add tests for", "test this component", "e2e test", "create test for", "test this page", or "test this feature".

say_en.text: Generate Playwright tests for the login feature.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the login flow and generate test files.
Claude will read the component source and generate tests.

say_en.text: Add e2e tests for the search page.
say_en.note: Claude will identify the search page and generate tests.
